name: How long does it take to install wainscoting in a room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install wainscoting in a room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing wainscoting in an average dining room or hallway typically takes one to three days. Day one focuses on measuring, leveling, cutting, and securing baseboards, vertical stiles, and cap rails. Day two involves filling nail holes, caulking seams, and applying primer. Day three covers the final coats of interior paint. Timelines expand if your walls require extensive drywall repairs, leveling, or if the layout requires fitting intricate trim around multiple doors, windows, and electrical boxes.
acceptedAnswer.description: An average room takes one to three days, including initial layout, trim carpentry, caulking, patching nail holes, and final interior painting.
